items.summary: At a PR-prep squash, correct two pushed commit bodies on moat-fix-465: 38f16ea3 says upstream 'now' uses cudaGetDeviceCount (it came from 2ee29780, already at the published head e994ef0b); daa1a7bf says the stale r_kp1_norm2_tot feeds beta and that fresh allocations hide it (it feeds only the PCG exit test, and from the second solver iteration on it adds onto the previous iteration's value).
